places-benizar-i-maina.story: 286 km from Socovos to Socovos, about 4 h 56 of riding. The stops in between: Lavadero Tello III, maina and back through Lavadero Tello III. The highest point is about 1,200 m. The line favours views over speed.

legend-sea-to-sky-highway.slogan: Sea-to-Sky Highway – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-sea-to-sky-highway.story: Vancouver to Whistler along Howe Sound. A one-way ride of 101 km, West End to Whistler - roughly 1 h 50 in the saddle. It goes by way of West Vancouver, Lions Bay and Squamish. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Sea-to-Sky Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 15 km this is Sea-to-Sky Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

legend-sea-to-sky-highway.storyWas: Vancouver to Whistler along Howe Sound.
